evals.prompt: We discussed a temporary SQL quote bug, a stable cache read path, and a decision that Git Markdown is the source of truth while embeddings are disposable. Update project knowledge only where durable.
evals.expected_output: Filters out the SQL quote bug, saves durable cache or architecture/decision knowledge under lifecycle-aware leaf note paths, and rebuilds indexes.

evals.prompt: Break down design.md into development-design/architecture/decisions, development-design/workflow/data-flow, development-design/workflow/process-flow, and development-design/architecture/patterns notes for project alpha. Keep traceability and do not apply changes yet.
evals.expected_output: Returns a plan-only breakdown table with every meaningful source point mapped to a lifecycle-aware leaf target note or update candidate, traceability, coverage report, conflicts, and suggested script commands.

evals.prompt: Use keep-summarizing for project alpha. Create a human-readable English project feature overview for stakeholder briefing.
evals.expected_output: Redirects reader-facing document creation to orch-create-document, states that keep-summarizing owns durable knowledge only, and does not create reader-facing output files or files inside .work-bundle/knowledge.

evals.prompt: Use keep-summarizing for project alpha. Create a Chinese speech draft output from curated knowledge and save it to knowledge/alpha/speech.md.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to create a reader-facing document inside a durable knowledge repo and redirects the request to orch-create-document under .work-bundle/orchestration/docs/.

evals.prompt: Run git status for project alpha knowledge, then try to run git status in the source repository.
evals.expected_output: Allows scoped Git status inside the selected project knowledge root and refuses to apply scoped Git authority to the source repository.

evals.prompt: Export embedding chunks for notes where one note is confidential and another is superseded.
evals.expected_output: Excludes confidential and superseded notes from embedding export while keeping Markdown as source of truth.

evals.prompt: The recipe constraint model is unresolved and we will resolve it later. Track it as a development-design/architecture/decisions open question for project alpha with triggers recipe constraints and step constraints.
evals.expected_output: Creates a standalone open-question watchpoint under open-questions/development-design/architecture/decisions/, records trigger terms, rebuilds open-question-registry.jsonl, and does not mix it into normal durable notes.

evals.prompt: Current work discusses recipe constraints and answers the tracked step constraints model question. Ask what to do with the matching open question.
evals.expected_output: Uses trigger-term matching to surface the matching open-question watchpoint and asks whether to mark resolved, keep open, split, or ignore.

evals.prompt: Index v3 notes containing confirmed, proposed, rejected, and implemented cache knowledge, then query for implementation_plan context.
evals.expected_output: Builds a derived SQLite FTS index from Markdown, retrieves across statuses, labels results as authority, candidate, background, or blocked, and treats only confirmed, implemented, and current as default authority.

evals.prompt: Doctor a v3 note with lifecycle_stage development_design stored under notes/development-design and an implemented note without front matter evidence.
evals.expected_output: Accepts deterministic underscore-to-hyphen lifecycle path normalization and reports missing front matter evidence for the implemented note.

evals.prompt: Run a v3 migration dry run over legacy perspective-only notes.
evals.expected_output: Writes migration/v3-inventory.jsonl with candidate lifecycle stage, candidate perspective, candidate status, confidence, reason, and action, and marks ambiguous or mixed notes for manual review instead of silently promoting them.

evals.prompt: Use what-is-helpful gateway mode for an implementation_plan query where relevant notes exist in customer-design, development-design, implementation, and operation lifecycle partitions with mixed current, proposed, rejected, and superseded statuses.
evals.expected_output: Discovers relevant candidates across all allowed lifecycle partitions before lifecycle and status authority classification, validates materially relevant candidates, returns the smallest useful classified set grouped as authority, candidate, background, or blocked, allows only authority to shape the implementation plan, and keeps relevant non-authority notes visible with uncertainty or incompatibility rationale.

evals.prompt: Use what-is-helpful gateway mode for a knowledge retrieval optimization task. Build the query from feature and workflow anchors, then retrieve candidates that match exact terms and semantic wording.
evals.expected_output: Forms polarity-neutral and stage/perspective/status-neutral anchors from the requested artifact, feature, functionality, component, file, API, schema, workflow, or explicit names; uses the approved ks.py query surface for hybrid SQLite FTS plus vector candidate discovery; and treats vector distance, FTS rank, fusion rank, and policy hints as mechanical retrieval metadata only.

evals.prompt: Durable notes changed after a keep-summarizing write. Refresh indexes for project alpha and report completion.
evals.expected_output: Runs index maintenance through ks-maintain-indexes, rebuilds or reports status for document registry, chunk registry, SQLite FTS, vector index artifacts, embedding manifest or chunk hashes, and open-question registry when relevant, and reports vector status as rebuilt, unavailable, skipped, or failed before claiming completion.

evals.prompt: Before writing a new note, check whether existing knowledge duplicates or conflicts with this feature. Use any index data that helps.
evals.expected_output: Checks duplicates and conflicts through approved neutral query surfaces, does not browse document-registry.jsonl, chunk-registry.jsonl, or open-question-registry.jsonl as the exploration surface, and keeps JSONL files as maintained machine-readable derived outputs.

evals.prompt: A hybrid query returns one candidate with close vector distance and another note that appears to oppose the requested workflow change. Decide what the output should say.
evals.expected_output: Uses script output only as mechanical candidates and trace evidence; the agent classifies relevance, authority, polarity, materiality, and blocker status; surfaces opposing or constraining evidence when material; and leaves unresolved material conflicts for the user instead of letting scripts or vector similarity decide truth.

evals.prompt: Query project knowledge while the current directory is deep inside a managed multi-repository member.
evals.expected_output: Walks upward to the containing workspace_root, reads durable knowledge only from workspace_root/.work-bundle/knowledge, keeps any source inspection scoped to the member project_root, and uses registry lookup only as a bounded fallback.

evals.prompt: A multi-repository workspace has script/index.yaml and protected credentials/credentials.yaml while knowledge indexes are rebuilt.
evals.expected_output: Treats singular script/ as workspace utility metadata without executing utilities, excludes credentials/credentials.yaml and all credential values from reading, indexing, embedding, or output, and keeps toolkit scripts/ separate.

v4_evals.description: Validate v4 compact runtime and boundary behavior.
